author: Codex
name: Library Tweaks
description: Small tweaks for the native Zen Library. Currently adds a Saves (bookmarks) section.

background/urlbar.sys.mjs.name: Saves urlbar provider
background/urlbar.sys.mjs.description: Natural-language bookmark search in the urlbar. Imported once per process.

background/cks-bootstrap.sys.mjs.name: Keyboard Shortcuts section bootstrap
background/cks-bootstrap.sys.mjs.description: Registers the about:preferences actor that groups Library shortcuts. Imported once per process.

background/cks-section-child.sys.mjs.name: Keyboard Shortcuts section actor
background/cks-section-child.sys.mjs.description: Runs inside about:preferences and relocates Library rows under one header. Loaded by the actor system.

features/saves.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Saves
features/saves.uc.js.description: Saves (bookmarks) section for the native Zen Library.

features/tweak-media.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Media menu
features/tweak-media.uc.js.description: Rename and Delete for native Media items.

features/tweak-history.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - History menu
features/tweak-history.uc.js.description: Right-click options for native History items.

features/tweak-anim.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Section animation
features/tweak-anim.uc.js.description: Entrance animation when switching library sections.

features/tweak-boosts.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Boosts UI
features/tweak-boosts.uc.js.description: Grouped, tiled Boosts presentation for the native section.

features/tweak-downloads.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Downloads extras
features/tweak-downloads.uc.js.description: On-device files group and rename support for native Downloads.

features/tweak-history-section.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - History section
features/tweak-history-section.uc.js.description: Recently closed tabs and Clear history for native History.

features/tweak-cks-section.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Keyboard Shortcuts section
features/tweak-cks-section.uc.js.description: Groups Library shortcuts under one header in Keyboard Shortcuts settings.
